In this landmark judgment, the Hon'ble Supreme Court provided clear and binding guidelines for matrimonial proceedings, specifically concerning claims for monetary relief.

The Court ruled that any party seeking monetary relief--whether maintenance,
compensation, or any other financial assistance-- must file an affidavit disclosing their assets and liabilities.
This obligation applies not only at the initiation of the proceedings but also during the pendency of the case, ensuring transparency and fairness in the process.

Furthermore, the Court emphasized that failure to comply with this mandatory requirement would result in the party being barred from seeking any monetary relief from the other party until such time as the affidavit is filed.

14. In accordance with these Supreme Court guidelines, this Court issued an order on 17.09.2024,
directing both parties to file their respective affidavits of disclosure of assets and liabilities.

Despite these multiple opportunities, neither party submitted the required affidavits by the specified dates.

19. Point No.3:-

In view of discussion held above, this Court proceed to pass the following:
ORDER
The petition filed by the petitioner under Section 12 of Protection of Woman from Domestic Violence Act., is partly allowed.
The respondents are hereby restrained from committing any domestic violence against the petitioner.
However, the other reliefs prayed for by the petitioner is rejected.
